title: deprecate-legacy-operator-roles-add-attribute-rewrite-and-kms-residency-gate
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR migrates legacy operator role checks to RBAC v2 by adding an attribute-rewrite layer that canonicalizes incoming operator claims, introduces an audit canonicalizer for deterministic audit IDs across regions, and wires a KMS residency gate used by Private/Dedicated deployments to enforce region pinning policy. Motivation: reduce accidental over-privilege from heterogeneous operator tokens and make audit trails canonical for compliance auditors, while preventing KMS requests from crossing tenant region boundaries. Changes include a dry-run linter for existing policies, a canary rollout plan, and a migration-helper CLI to generate RBAC v2 bind templates. Testing: unit tests for the rewrite engine and canonicalizer, thermal integration tests simulating multi-region KMS proxies, and a staged rollout to Dedicated clusters with feature-flag gating. Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration test harness added, [x] migration CLI, [x] docs updated, [x] canary rollout plan included.
